steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen from the event creation flow.
Enable saving eRFX projects as drafts.
Enable eRFX project creation for the tenant.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage, avoiding the unsupported manual stage-menu sequence.
Work on the RFQ stage where its template and pricing sheet are configured.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Verify the project contains exactly one line item before saving.
Save the configured eRFX project as a draft.
Verify that Procol reports a successful draft save.
Return to the Events list to verify where the saved project appears.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the saved project is listed among drafts.
